detailed_descriptions_html.en:
Rule the undergrowth with all the extras in the Empires of the Undergrowth Supporter Pack:

  • The Myrmecia ereptor ant species available as an alternative skin to replace the Formica ereptor workers and Queen in-game

  • An OST featuring 170 minutes of in-game music spread across 35 tracks, all available as uncompressed WAV files

  • Sounds of the Undergrowth widget to listen to the music and voice-lines in-game

  • 7 4k wallpapers with multiple variations for a total of 16 wallpapers

  • 19 emojis, with some based on the game’s achievement icons

  • 12 portraits
